title: Bill 111 on removing belongings from public places
summary: The chair urged commissioners on November 21 to watch a December 3 meeting and review Bill 111, which covers removal and storage of personal property. A testifier said people could not get back belongings taken in homeless sweeps. The council sent the bill to committee in July.
